title: Just lovely!
text: Just lovely!. While not perfectly wrinkle free, it came out of the dryer ready to put on the table  like it was.  I could have pressed, but I didn't.  This runner was wonderfully made, and the reverse, in a green gingham check could be used as well for a different look.  I am well please with the purchase, a little pricy, but so well made, it was worth it.  I got the placemats as well, very nice too.  For an Easter gift I gave my daughter-in-law 2 sets of napkins which she loved.  Will get her the full set for her bday! Great purchase.
